jobs.description: MSL at AstraZeneca Skip to main content Medical Liaison Search jobs MSL Location Kfar Saba, Central District, Israel Job ID R-257388 Date posted 29/07/2026 Apply MSL Introduction to role: Are you ready to turn scientific dialogue into real-world patient impact across your territory? Do you want to use your scientific credibility and business acumen to shape treatment pathways and inform brand strategy while staying close to the evidence? As an MSL at AstraZeneca, you will build trusted scientific partnerships with Key External Experts and healthcare professionals, translating the latest data into meaningful insights and actions. You will be 60% field-based, engaging face-to-face across your territory and partnering closely with an office-based Medical Affairs Manager for your therapeutic area to connect scientific strategy with on-the-ground reality. In this role, you will help align medical and commercial objectives without compromising on ethics—fueling our growth and enabling continued investment in research. Your work will ensure that the right data reaches the right stakeholders at the right time, improving decision-making and, ultimately, patient outcomes. Accountabilities: Scientific Exchange and Insight Generation: Conduct high-quality scientific discussions with KEEs and HCPs; gather and synthesize field insights to inform medical strategy and brand planning.Therapeutic Area Mastery: Maintain up-to-date expertise on the TA, treatment paradigms, and competitor data through literature review, congress attendance, and expert engagement.Account Plan Execution: Deliver medical components of account plans to time and budget, ensuring activities address identified gaps and opportunities.Expert Partnership Development: Build deep, trust-based relationships with KEEs; map interests, identify collaboration opportunities, and support local practice change.Evidence Discussion and Data Gap Identification: Present and discuss key data sets to uncover evidence gaps, patient pathways, and unmet needs aligned to TA strategy.Scientific Events and Education: Initiate and co-create scientific events with KEEs; lead journal clubs and one-to-one scientific exchanges that elevate disease and therapy understanding.Digital Medical Engagement: Produce compliant scientific digital content (e.g., newsletters, approved emails) as part of integrated medical plans to broaden reach and impact.Field Intelligence and Internal Collaboration: Share actionable insights with cross-functional teams; contribute to the core strategic plan and educate key account managers and colleagues on disease and therapies.Clinical Study and Early Access Support: Support AZ-sponsored clinical studies (site selection and initiation) and contribute to bridging/early access programs where relevant.Externally Sponsored Research and Funding Stewardship: Manage ESRs, grants, donations, and third-party scientific sponsorships with rigor and transparency.Real-World Evidence and Care Transformation: Identify partners, including KEEs and Sick Funds, to develop real-world data initiatives and care-improvement projects that enable local practice change.Network and Best Practice Sharing: Collaborate with MSLs across countries and TAs to exchange best practices and continuously evolve the role.Congress Participation: Attend national congresses and, as required, represent the TA at international meetings to bring back insights and strengthen external networks.Medical Information and Documentation: Respond to medical information requests via approved platforms; document all interactions thoroughly and on time in the designated systems.Compliance and Continuous Improvement: Complete all training; uphold AZ policies and external codes; seek feedback through training and joint field visits to refine communication and insight-gathering skills. You will join a team that brings medical experts, commercial thinkers, and innovators into the same room to unlock bold ideas—always guided by evidence and strong ethics. We move with agility, learn fast from what works and what doesn’t, and stay close to a broad, science-led pipeline that keeps our work varied and meaningful. Your insights from the field will shape decisions across the business, helping us invest wisely in research while improving how patients are diagnosed, treated, and cared for. jobs.description: Lung Cancer Specialist-Center-North at AstraZeneca Skip to main content Oncology Sales Search jobs Lung Cancer Specialist-Center-North Location Kfar Saba, Central District, Israel Job ID R-258544 Date posted 05/09/2026 Apply Job Title: Lung Cancer Specialist-Center-North Introduction to role Are you ready to change the trajectory of lung cancer by turning cutting-edge science into real-world impact? Do you thrive in a fast-moving environment where bold ideas and crisp execution accelerate better outcomes for patients and the business? In this field-based role, you will lead the commercial strategy and execution for our lung cancer portfolio across the Center-North territory, translating brand priorities into measurable results. You will uncover opportunities across the patient journey, remove barriers to optimal care, and ensure that the right patients receive the right medicine at the right time. Working closely with cross-functional partners, you will bring clarity, urgency and precision to a complex market. This position is designed for impact from day one. Expect four days per week in the field building relationships and driving performance, and one day focused on planning, learning and project work. Your ownership of the territory will help shape care pathways and fuel launches that redefine standards of care. Accountabilities - Sales Excellence and Territory Leadership: Achieve or exceed lung cancer portfolio targets by building and executing a territory plan aligned to brand and therapy-area priorities. Focus resources where they will create the greatest clinical and commercial impact and manage budgets for maximum return.- Insight-Driven Execution: Use sales, market and customer data to map the patient journey, quantify gaps and risks, and set clear priorities. Continuously adapt plans to changes in competition, guidelines and local treatment dynamics to sustain momentum.- Customer Engagement and Omnichannel Impact: Build trusted, long-term relationships with oncologists and wider care teams. Deliver relevant, personalized engagements across face-to-face, digital and omnichannel channels. Lead or support customer initiatives that address bottlenecks in diagnosis, testing and treatment, and feed insights into territory and cross-functional planning.- Oncology Knowledge and Cross-Functional Collaboration: Maintain deep understanding of disease biology, treatment pathways, our medicines and the competitive landscape. Communicate approved scientific and product information clearly. Partner with Brand, Medical, Market Access and Diagnostics to align opportunities and execute launches and strategic initiatives with excellence.- Compliance and Professional Standards: Conduct all activities in line with AstraZeneca’s Code of Ethics, policies, local regulations and industry standards. Uphold integrity, transparency and professionalism in every interaction.- Immediate to Long-Term Impact: In your first 90 days, establish a sharp territory plan, map priority accounts and secure early wins. Over time, shape pathway adoption, enable successful indications and launches, and contribute to repeatable commercial excellence across the portfolio. Essential Skills/Experience - Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, healthcare, business or a related field.- Proven experience in pharmaceutical or specialty-care sales.- Demonstrated success in achieving sales and business objectives.- Strong communication, influencing, negotiation and presentation skills.- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management capabilities.- Ability to interpret data and translate insights into actions.- Ability to manage a complex territory independently and work effectively in a cross-functional environment.- Proficiency with CRM systems, digital tools and data-driven decision-making. Desirable Skills/Experience - Previous oncology or specialty-care experience.- Understanding of cancer care pathways and treatment guidelines.- Experience launching new products or indications in a competitive market.- Experience in strategic account management.- Omnichannel customer-engagement experience. Why AstraZeneca Join a team where science and enterprise move in lockstep to deliver transformative medicines to people living with cancer. You will operate at pace, trusted to make smart, data-grounded decisions and encouraged to challenge convention when it accelerates patient impact. Expect unexpected teams in the same room—medical experts, data minds and commercial leaders—co-creating solutions and acting quickly. Our pipeline is deep and advancing fast, creating meaningful opportunities to lead launches, shape care environments and see the results of your work in clinics. We value kindness alongside ambition, empowering you to take ownership, speak up and grow as you deliver for patients. Call to Action If you are ready to turn bold science into better outcomes for people with lung cancer across the Center-North territory, step forward and apply to shape what comes next! We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.
